headline: iFixit's look inside the iPhone Duo may explain those broken screens and hinges
summary: iFixit performed a teardown of the new iPhone Duo. They uncovered details about the folding screen's crease. The device received a 5/10 repairability score, a notable achievement for a foldable.

headline: Scott Walker's The Drift will get under your skin
summary: This review delves into Scott Walker's unsettling 2006 album, 'The Drift.' The music is described as genuinely terrifying and disturbing. Walker explores deeply uncomfortable themes throughout the record.

headline: A YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo and thinks he found the cause of crackgate
summary: Reports of iPhone Duo screens cracking quickly are widespread on social media. Users describe hinge issues leading to audible cracks and broken displays. The consistent location of cracks suggests a potential design flaw.

headline: Zen Browser is the Arc replacement I was looking for
summary: The innovative Arc browser was acquired by Atlassian, which shifted focus to its AI-centric browser, Dia. Many users are seeking an alternative to the discontinued Arc. Zen Browser is presented as a promising replacement for Arc's unique design.

headline: Eric Bauza, Voice Acting Legend Behind Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, Dead at 46
summary: Legendary voice actor Eric Bauza has passed away at 46. He was renowned for voicing iconic characters like Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck. Bauza brought numerous classic animated figures to life.

headline: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Gets Surprise 10th Anniversary Update This Week
summary: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is receiving a surprise 10th-anniversary update this week. Bandai Namco announced the update as fans anticipate a third installment. The fighting game series continues to engage its audience a decade on.

headline: Mass Effect's Commander Shepard Actors, Destiny Community Help #SaveMassEffect Petition Cross 200,000 Signatures
summary: The #SaveMassEffect petition has surpassed 200,000 signatures. Both Commander Shepard actors publicly supported the fan-led movement. The Destiny community also boosted the petition's reach.

headline: Phantom Blade Zero Review
summary: Phantom Blade Zero delivers memorable and challenging boss fights. The game features compelling and fluid combat mechanics. It showcases an undeniable sense of style and confidence.

headline: How Lula turned it around to beat former president's son
summary: Brazil's left-wing President Lula secured a fourth term in office. He narrowly defeated right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The election concluded with a knife-edge vote count.

headline: Clean-up under way as Storm Boelo leaves 90,000 without power
summary: Storm Boelo has caused widespread disruption across Scotland and northern England. Strong winds resulted in approximately 90,000 properties losing power. Clean-up efforts are now actively underway across affected regions.

headline: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
summary: Serbia's long-serving populist leader, Vučić, has lost the recent election. A student-led protest movement claimed victory, sparking celebrations. Vučić conceded defeat in a vote seen as a referendum on the country's future.

headline: Knighting Sinfield 'easiest decision anyone's had to make,' says Prince William
summary: Prince William declared knighting rugby league star Kevin Sinfield an 'easiest decision.' He praised Sinfield as 'gold dust' for his contributions. William added that Sinfield 'should have been Sir Kevin years ago.'
